quests.note: SoulFire feeds both the Fiery Avenger and the Torrid Corruptor.

steps.title: Hand Tykar Renlin four Drom's Champagne
steps.zone: East Freeport, Seafarer's Roost bar

steps.title: Hand the prisoner Bog Juice, Edible Goo and Bunker Cell #1
steps.zone: West Freeport, arena prison cell
steps.note: Bog Juice is brewed (Bottle, Snake Scales, Water Flask); Edible Goo is cooked (Fire Beetle Eye, Rat Ears). Don't eat it.

steps.title: Hand H. K. 102 to Assistant Kiolna
steps.zone: Highpass Keep, the bank

steps.title: Hand Altunic Jartin a Cloth Shirt
steps.zone: East Commons, hut across from the inn

steps.title: Hand Merko Quetalis a Spider Venom Sac
steps.zone: North Freeport, Hall of Truth courtyard
steps.note: Any giant spider drops the sac.

steps.title: Hand Merko both tokens, then kill Guard Willia in the sewers
steps.zone: North Freeport; Guard Willia spawns in the Freeport sewers (moat wall opening)

steps.title: Hand Merko Quetalis the Token of Truth
steps.zone: North Freeport, Hall of Truth courtyard

steps.title: Kill Xicotl for the Glowing Sword Hilt
steps.zone: Castle Mistmoore, pool room · rare; a naked dark elf is the placeholder

steps.title: Kill Sir Lucan D'Lere twice — militia, then undead
steps.zone: West Freeport
steps.note: The first kill spawns the undead form, which drops the Testimony of Truth.

steps.title: Hand Valeron Dushire the Testimony of Truth
steps.zone: North Freeport, Hall of Truth balcony

steps.title: Hand Brother Hayle the Sealed Note — alone
steps.zone: Splitpaw Lair, jail cells

steps.title: Hand Brother Hayle the Note, Testimony, Glowing Sword Hilt and Brilliant Sword of Faith
steps.zone: Splitpaw Lair, jail cells

steps.title: Kill Brother Hayle, loot the Burning Soul of the Pious, right-click it
steps.zone: Splitpaw Lair, prison area 6 · the man who handed you SoulFire

steps.title: Loot a Dark Reaver from a ghoul cavalier
steps.zone: Lower Guk, dead side

steps.title: Hand the clicked soul and the Dark Reaver to Lord Grimrot (the living one)
steps.zone: South Karana (1377, 1172)
steps.reply: You have served me well. You may yet prove useful to my master.
steps.note: You get the soul back as a non-clickable item. Bloodsabers +100.

steps.title: Kill Lord Grimrot, loot the Burning Soul of the Pestilent, right-click it
steps.zone: South Karana (1377, 1172)
steps.note: Also drops a Pestilence Scythe with one charge of Vampiric Curse (not lore).

steps.title: Pay Dason Goldblade 500 platinum to spawn Inte Akera
steps.zone: Plane of Sky, Efreeti chamber (quest room)
steps.note: Inte Akera appears in the Island 4 windmill for a few minutes.

steps.title: Kill Inte Akera, loot the Burning Soul of the Virtuous, right-click it
steps.zone: Plane of Sky, Island 4 windmill · level 55 Paladin
steps.reply: Greetings. I am Inte Akera. I have retired to the Plane of Sky after a long life toiling on Norrath's soil.

steps.title: Tell Luxio Nulsis "I still seek guidance", then hand in the three souls and SoulFire
steps.zone: East Freeport, Shadow Knight / Necromancer guild · he brushes off a plain hail
steps.reply: So, you've finally sought me out. … as a fellow knight, I will take the sword and the three souls you've collected. This burden I will carry for you.

steps.title: Hold both swords: Ghoulbane and SoulFire
steps.npc: Lord Nagafen, Talendor or Severilous · Vox, Gorenaire or Faydedar
steps.zone: Ghoulbane drops from the fire dragons; SoulFire comes from Zimel's Blades

steps.title: Hand in both torn books and 1000 platinum for the Book of Scale
steps.zone: Blind Fish Tavern, Neriak Commons · or the North Qeynos newbie yard
steps.note: The burnt book drops from Nagafen, Talendor or Severilous; the frost-covered one from Vox, Gorenaire or Faydedar.
steps.reply: Take this book quickly and tell no one about this.

steps.title: Hand the Book of Scale to the Oracle of K'Arnon
steps.zone: Ocean of Tears
steps.reply: Unbelievable! The legendary Book of Scale is mine!

steps.title: Hand the Phylactery to the Lich of Miragul, then kill Miragul
steps.zone: Everfrost Peaks, underwater ice caves (north)
steps.note: Only the character who handed in the Phylactery gets the drops. Miragul is a level 53 Necromancer.

steps.title: Pay Dason Goldblade 500 platinum (and return the book) to spawn Inte Akera
steps.zone: Plane of Sky, Efreeti room (quest cave)
steps.note: Inte Akera stands in the Island 4 windmill for five minutes.

steps.title: Hand Inte Akera SoulFire alone, then Ghoulbane alone
steps.zone: Plane of Sky, Island 4 windmill
steps.note: Two separate trades: SoulFire gives the Blessing of Nobility, Ghoulbane the Blessing of Sacrifice.

steps.title: Hand Inte Akera Miragul's Head, Miragul's Robe and both Blessings together
steps.zone: Plane of Sky, Island 4 windmill
